rules: No previously rejected painting is offered again by default in the same module.
A new vote is a proposed editorial revision; it never silently deletes an existing historical approval.
Better photograph is a photo research request, not rejection of the work.
Another section is a proposed cross-placement; target section must be specified.
All sources are research previews; framed, glary, cropped, rights-held or low-resolution photography is not automatically production-approved.
